description: Pinned external lncRNA catalogs for F2.1/F2.2. Fill `version` and `url` with the exact pinned release before running --mode download. `file` may be set to an existing local BED instead of downloading. Feature counts and md5 are recorded in run_info/external_catalogs.tsv.

sources.name: lncipedia
sources.note: LNCipedia hg38 BED (BED6 or BED12). Record the exact release used.

sources.name: noncode
sources.note: NONCODE hg38 BED (BED6 or BED12). Record the exact release used.

sources.name: rnacentral
sources.note: Optional. RNAcentral hg38 lncRNA BED, if easily available.

sources.name: fantomcat
sources.note: Optional. FANTOM CAT, only if an hg38 BED exists.
